assignments.scope: Complete the existing v0.1.1 code-only handoff: preserve identical ZIP bytes, make the artifact privately retrievable in the Owner-authorized Handoffs project folder if access exists, independently re-read uploaded bytes where possible, and append a public-safe GitHub receipt with opaque private locator; if no authorized upload/readback capability, report BLOCKED with exact gap. Do not rebuild or modify P2.1/runnable.

next.instruction: Owner sends Cycle now to the same coder; coder confirms real private ZIP access/upload and receipt. Do not trigger reviewer without a retrievable artifact.

progress_projection.reason: Cycle rev2 reconciles coder-reported PARTIAL receipt; Progress Page project remains NOT_CREATED and no official CLI publication has been verified.

activation_scope: Manual GitHub issue receipt pilot for existing code-only return; no engineering transfer authorization, release, or automatic dispatch.
